series.name: EPICA Dome C (Antarctica)
series.baseline: mean of the last 1,000 years, at Dome C (the source's own)
series.credit: Jouzel et al. 2007, Science 317: 793, doi:10.1126/science.1141038; data doi:10.1594/PANGAEA.683655, CC BY 3.0
series.note: Antarctic temperature, not global: polar change is about twice the global one. Means of 200-year bins within 20,000 years and 1,000-year bins beyond.

series.name: Last Glacial Maximum Reanalysis
series.baseline: each ensemble member's 100 BP bin (about 1850, roughly pre-industrial)
series.credit: Osman et al. 2021, Nature 599: 239, doi:10.1038/s41586-021-03984-4; NOAA NCEI, accessed 2026-11-12; no licence stated; NOAA NCEI asks users to cite the publication, the online resource and the date accessed
series.note: 200-year bins; median and 95% range of 500 ensemble members.

series.name: PAGES 2k Consortium
series.baseline: 1850-1900, shifted from 1961-1990 by HadCRUT5's mean for 1850-1900
series.credit: PAGES 2k Consortium (Neukom et al.) 2019, Nature Geoscience 12: 643, doi:10.1038/s41561-019-0400-0; NOAA NCEI, accessed 2026-11-12; no licence stated; NOAA NCEI asks users to cite the publication, the online resource and the date accessed
series.note: 31-year filtered; median and 95% range of a 7,000-member multi-method ensemble.

series.name: HadCRUT5
series.credit: Morice et al. 2021, JGR Atmospheres 126, doi:10.1029/2019JD032361; HadCRUT.5.1.0.0, Met Office, Open Government Licence v3
series.note: Annual means; the last year may be incomplete when the file was downloaded.
